embeds.title: PSBL CONSOLATION BRACKET
embeds.description: The bracket for the six franchises that miss the playoffs.

fields.name: THE FORMAT
fields.value: Same structure as the playoffs, played in the same weeks, seeded by regular-season standings among non-playoff teams (Article XVI).

fields.name: THE PRIZE
fields.value: The consolation champion receives a **$50 FAAB bonus** for the following season (Article X).

fields.name: WHAT IT DOESN'T CHANGE
fields.value: Consolation results do not change annual draft order, standings or the Presidents' Trophy.

fields.name: DISCUSSION
fields.value: Owners can react here but not post. Talk about it in **💬│gm-lounge** or **😂│chirps-and-memes**.
